implementation.targetScope: Secure nanoid/customAlphabet/customRandom/random/urlAlphabet and non-secure subpath for Node 24, Bun 1.4.4 and modern browsers. PostCSS 8.5.8 consumes non-secure nanoid(6).
implementation.remainingWork: Release and VentiMath adoption. CLI and legacy runtime shims are outside this module contract.

changes: Independent runtime from public API declarations, documentation and black-box behavior; no upstream implementation source copied.
Secure IDs use platform cryptography, power-of-two masking or unbiased rejection sampling. No Math.random fallback.
Returned random byte arrays have independent ownership; pool refills cannot mutate them.
Invalid sizes/alphabets and malformed or stalled custom random sources fail explicitly. Size cap is 1 MiB. Custom deterministic sequences are not upstream byte-for-byte compatible.
Private per-generator character reservoirs amortize byte-to-character encoding while consuming every accepted random symbol once. No identifier result is cached or reused.

Non-secure six-character IDs use a fixed-length path; other URL IDs avoid the generic alphabet closure. One fresh Math.random draw per symbol and the existing mapping, validation, zero-size behavior and secure implementation are preserved.
